clips.title: The story
paras: Fiora Longears sends Alliance travelers from Theramore north to Astranaar. There, they report to Shindrell Swiftfire in Ashenvale, where the night elves face war and unrest.

Alliance travelers arrive in Dustwallow Marsh aboard the ferry from Menethil Harbor, often seeking purpose in northern Kalimdor. At Theramore, Fiora Longears directs capable hands inland toward Astranaar, Ashenvale's main night elven settlement. The route winds beneath ancient, shadowed canopies and leads into a forest strained by war and unrest.

Fiora tells travelers not to mention her name in Astranaar because Shindrell Swiftfire does not know her. Fiora's role is to direct fresh Alliance talent where it is needed. Shindrell welcomes able-bodied defenders when they arrive. Ashenvale remains breathtaking, but it is no longer the peaceful sanctuary it once was.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... Go to Astranaar. I'm sure an eager member of the Alliance such as you can do some real good there. Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.
But don't bother mentioning who sent you. Shindrell does not know me...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are here to offer your services to the Alliance, friend? We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... Ashenvale Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
